title: Des Knaben Wunderhorn: Rheinlegendchen
notable_excerpt: Own MIDI render 19.89–34.89s; opening melody / theme
video_use_ideas: Use the lilting melody for a light landscape or hopeful interlude.
legal_notes: Composition and German text public domain (historic publication; composer d.1911). OpenScore Lieder repository README explicitly releases these scores under CC0 1.0; LICENSE.txt checked. Voice-and-piano edition. MIDI exported from the native MuseScore score to preserve hidden playback tempos; Rheinlegendchen uses the repository MusicXML with explicit playback tempos. The notated vocal line is played as GM oboe, not sung. Courtesy credit requested by source: OpenScore Lieder — https://github.com/OpenScore/Lieder (optional under CC0). Preview is an own FluidSynth render (FluidR3_GM), 15 seconds with fades and loudness normalisation; no third-party recording used.
licence_meaning: PD / CC0 / PDM / US-gov recording and score. Commercial use, no credit needed (courtesy credit still listed where the source asks).
